bot.records.doc: Every bot as engine data: its record, its main session and the size of its instructions.

bot.create.doc: Makes a bot: a folder under the home's bots/ with its record and instructions file; its id comes from its name.

bot.edit.doc: Changes a bot's record or instructions for the user; the next turn uses it.

bot.remove.doc: Archives a bot: its whole folder moves to the home's archive, from which bot.restore brings it back; nothing is deleted.

bot.archived.doc: The archived bots the person can bring back.

bot.restore.doc: Brings an archived bot back as it was; refused while another bot has its id.

bot.instructions.get.doc: A bot's instructions file as it is now, for the person editing it.

bot.pluginSettings.doc: One bot's values of every plugin's bot-scoped settings, with their schema, for a window to draw generically.

bot.conversation.doc: A page of one bot's single conversation, newest last (its main session's history); sealed card fields never reach a plugin.

bot.summaries.doc: Each bot's last line of activity, its time and whether the user has read it, for MOSS's list.

bot.markRead.doc: The user has read a bot's conversation up to a time: its unread dot goes.

bot.move.status.doc: The move of plugin bots into records: what it did, which plugin bots still wait for it (tried again at each start), or why it is held.

bot_record_changed.doc: A bot was made or its record or instructions changed.

bot_summary_changed.doc: A bot's last line or unread state changed.

bots_moved.doc: The one-time move of plugin bots into records ran.
